nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint256) tracking token balances of each account; mutated by SimpleERC20Token, transfer and transferFrom.
Public string token name initialized to 'COLOMBIA_WINS'; constant metadata, never mutated.
Public string token symbol initialized to 'COLWII'; constant metadata.
Public uint8 token decimals set to 18; constant metadata.
Public uint256 total token supply; read during the constructor to mint the entire supply to msg.sender.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) of owner-authorized spending amounts; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Constructor/initializer that assigns the full totalSupply to msg.sender in balanceOf and emits the Transfer mint event.
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value) that checks the caller balance, debits the sender and credits the recipient, emitting Transfer.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value) that stores an allowance for msg.sender over spender and emits Approval.
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) that validates balance and allowance then moves tokens and decrements the allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as the balance/allowance key and as the mint recipient in the constructor.
Unsigned subtraction on the caller balance inside transfer; guarded by a require but still an unchecked arithmetic write path.
Unsigned addition crediting the recipient balance inside transfer; can only overflow if the value plus balance exceeds 2^256-1.
Unsigned subtraction decrementing the spender allowance inside transferFrom; guarded by require(value <= allowance[from][msg.sender]).
Recipient address argument of transfer, used as the key for the balance credit.
Amount argument of transfer, used to debit the sender and credit the recipient.
Address argument of approve authorized to spend on behalf of msg.sender.
Amount argument of approve stored in the allowance mapping.
Owner address argument of transferFrom whose balance and allowance are checked and reduced.
Recipient address argument of transferFrom credited with the transferred tokens.
Amount argument of transferFrom compared against balance and allowance and then subtracted.
Return flag of transfer, always set to true when the function completes.
Return flag of approve, always set to true when the function completes.
Return flag of transferFrom, always set to true when the function completes.

edges.reason: Constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
Constructor reads totalSupply to mint the full supply.
Constructor uses msg.sender as the mint recipient and balance key.
transfer reads msg.sender to locate the sender balance and to authorize the debit.
transfer consumes the 'to' parameter as the credit destination.
transfer consumes the 'value' parameter as the transfer amount.
transfer reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for both sender and recipient.
transfer executes the unsigned subtraction on the caller balance after the require check.
The 'value' parameter flows into the balance subtraction, driving potential underflow.
msg.sender selects the storage slot that is decremented by value.
transfer executes the unsigned addition crediting the recipient balance.
The 'value' parameter flows into the recipient balance addition, driving potential overflow.
The 'to' parameter selects the storage slot that is incremented.
transfer assigns the boolean return flag.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve consumes the 'spender' parameter as the allowance delegatee key.
approve consumes the 'value' parameter as the approved amount.
approve writes the allowance nested mapping.
approve assigns the boolean return flag.
transferFrom uses msg.sender to constrain the allowance entry it may spend, relying on caller identity for authorization.
transferFrom consumes the 'from' parameter as the debited owner address.
transferFrom consumes the 'to' parameter as the credited recipient address.
transferFrom consumes the 'value' parameter as the transferred amount.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom executes the unsigned subtraction on the allowance entry.
The 'value' parameter flows into the allowance subtraction, driving potential underflow.
The 'from' parameter selects the allowance owner slot being decremented.
msg.sender selects the spender slot of the allowance mapping being decremented.
transferFrom assigns the boolean return flag.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter of transfer is only meaningful as an argument of the transfer function, so it collapses into that core function node.
The 'value' parameter of transfer directly drives the balanceOf[msg.sender] subtraction unsafe operation.
The 'spender' parameter exists solely as an argument of approve and normalizes into that function.
The 'value' parameter of approve is only used to set the allowance inside approve and normalizes into that function.
The 'from' parameter is exclusively an argument of transferFrom and normalizes into that function.
The 'to' parameter of transferFrom is exclusively an argument of that function and normalizes into it.
The 'value' parameter of transferFrom directly drives the allowance decrement unsafe operation.
The local success flag is a return value wholly internal to transfer and merges into that function node.
The local success flag is a return value wholly internal to approve and merges into that function node.
The local success flag is a return value wholly internal to transferFrom and merges into that function node.
